g.text: The three capabilities as movements of a nesting tree (spatial view, before and after)
process, the one exercising the capability
sibling process that rides along unchanged
— the bag the whole term sits in
IN — a sibling becomes a child. C-G (Red In);
OUT — a child becomes a sibling of its parent. C-G (Red Out);
OPEN — a boundary is DISSOLVED. C-G (Red Open);
Q is spliced into the caller's
